grader.scenario: Slow upload speeds impacting cloud video backups for home photography business
grader.notes: Complex full-fibre bandwidth troubleshooting call by Umar resolving an accidental 10Mbps upstream traffic-shaping lock following an automated firmware update. Umar re-provisions the symmetrical profile during an announced 75s hold, restoring 885Mbps upload speeds. However, Umar fails Active Listening by re-asking for LAN port and cable details given 14 minutes earlier, and fails Confirmed Resolved by rushing to terminate the call due to incoming call queues.
